deviations.what: VERIFIED.json reports all_ok false: the frozen check recomputed_contrasts_match failed.
deviations.cause: verify.py compares every field of every contrast with tolerance 1e-9, including the descriptive share of drugs with a negative difference. ROWS_killers.csv stores floats to about 16 significant digits. In A3 (route_lit vs route_nolit), 37 killers have identical routes in both arms, and one pair differed only in its last bits in memory, so after the round trip one drug moved from 'negative' to 'tie' (share_negative 0.4257 -> 0.4158).
deviations.effect: None on any registered quantity. Every estimate, 95% and family-wise interval matches RESULTS.json within 8.3e-17, every verdict and the headline match (VERIFIED_SUPPLEMENT.json). The other eight frozen checks pass.
deviations.handling: verify.py and VERIFIED.json are left as written. A labelled post-freeze script, verify_supplement.py, recomputes with numeric tolerance on registered quantities and explains each share mismatch by ties in the CSV.

The prediction for A2 (forecaster added to the VC) was NOT_SUPPORTED (P(HARM) 0.28); it was HARM. 13 of 15 predictions held. Predictions are forecasts, not decision rules.
